title: 'Iron sharpens iron.' Davante Adams focused on making Rams better in Super Bowl quest

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'Iron sharpens iron.' Davante Adams focused on making Rams better in Super Bowl quest
sources.description: After suffering his fifth loss in the NFC championship game last January, veteran wide receiver Davante Adams is locked-in on helping the Rams reach the Super Bowl.
